Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Australia Women are out in the middle and are taking their respective field positons. However, Alyssa Healy has not come out due to her injury, so Tahlia McGrath is acting as stand-in skipper and Beth Mooney will be behind the stumps for this innings. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the two opners for India Women. Darcie Brown to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Australia Women have posted a huge total on the board. They will be confident enough to defend this one and take the series. India Women, on the other hand need to bat with a positve mindset and with an extra batter in their side, this is going to be an exciting chase. Let's see how things pan out. Stay tuned for the second essay.

India Women managed to get through the top order of Australia Women, but they had no answer to the power-hitting of Ellyse Perry and Ashleigh Gardner. They missed their lengths quite a bit and were smashed all around the park. Deepti Sharma was the only bowler who looked good and picked up couple of crucial wickets while Radha Yadav got one, but no one else could support them and now they have to chase a huge total. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma will need to give them a good start to have a chance of gun this total down.

Australia Women have put on another brilliant batting display here. They did not start that well losing Beth Mooney early, but Alyssa Healy played some lusty blow to counter attack before she had to retire hurt due to a tweaked muscle in her leg. Tahlia McGrath followed her soon after as well. After, that it was another Ellyse Perry show who stitched up an excellent partnership with Ashleigh Gardner of 94 runs. The latter fell before her half-century, but Perry continued her onslaught with Grace Harris who played a quick cameo as well. Ellyse Perry remained unbeaten on 72 off just 42 balls and took her side to a mamoth total of 188. It is now up to their bowlers to do their job and wrap up the series.

Australia Women have posted the highest total of this series! It was the duo of Ellyse Perry and Grace Harris that once again took the attack to India Women at the death overs. Now, India Women have a huge task on their hand to level the series.

Straight to the fielder! This is dragged down by Deepti Sharma outside off, Grace Harris tries to pull it hard but hits it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. The inning ends with a dot ball but Australia Women finish with 188/3 on the board.
Short and wide outside off, Ellyse Perry tries to cut it hard but finds the fielder at point. They do scamper through for one.
SIX! BANG! This is Ellyse Perry 2.0! Floated up around the off stump, Perry gets down on one knee and plays the slog-sweep. The connection is sweet and the ball sails over the mid-wicket fence.
SIX! Tossed up, full and outside off, Ellyse Perry is able to get under it and launches it right back over the bowler's head for a biggie.

Missed opportunity and they get an extra run as well. Deepti Sharma serves it well outside the off stump and a bit shorter, Ellyse Perry cuts it straight to cover-point and they set off for the single. Shafali Verma picks up the ball and throws it toward the bowler and Perry isn't even in the picture but Deepti fails to collect the ball and they get two.
Gives it a nice loop and tosses it well outside the off stump. Grace Harris shuffles and drags the slog towards wide long on for just a single.
Deepti Sharma (3-0-19-2) to bowl the last over.
Full and outside off again, Ellyse Perry looks to squeeze it behind backward point but hits it straight to the fielder at short third man.

Anjali Sarvani switches to around the wicket and angles in a full one from wide outside off. Ellyse Perry drives it square of the wicket but finds Smriti Mandhana at point and it will be a rare dot ball.
Full and around off, this is drilled down to long off for just a single this time.
SIX! Gets hold of this one! Length ball, angling across the off pole, Grace Harris goes deep in her crease and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.

FOUR! Powerfully struck! This is full and wide, Grace Harris reaches out and is able to loft it dead straight. The fielders from long off and long on are unable to get to it and it will be a boundary.
Australia Women are playing brilliantly here. Can they post the highest total of this series now?
Nicely bowled! On a nagging length and angling it across the left-hander. Grace Harris looks to play it late but is undone by the lack of pace.

FOUR! 16 off the over and Australia Women in the driving seat at the moment. Full and wide, just not full enough and Ellyse Perry throws her hands at it. The ball is hit square of the wicket and rockest into the cover fence.
WIDE! An attempted slower one, this is full and wide, pushed beyond the tramline outside off. A wide is called.
Firmly struck but just for a single. This is full and wide, Grace Harris drives it along the ground and toward wide long off for a single.
Very full and around off, Ellyse Perry digs it out towards long off for a single.
Slower one, full and at the stumps, this is driven down to long on for one.

FOUR! Renuka Singh tries to overcorrect and digs in a shortish ball around middle. This one sits up nicely for the batter and Grace Harris muscles it away behind the square on the leg side to make it back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Pure class from Grace Harris. This is full and wide, not a bad delivery at all but Harris waits for it and just opens the face of the bat to caress it past backward point for a boundary.

Hit hard but it's well fielded in the deep. Tossed up full and outside off, Grace Harris heaves it flat and hard towards wide long on. Harleen Deol from long on runs to her right and keeps it in play. Just the single taken.
FOUR! Edged away! Quicker and flatter outside off, Grace Harris goes hard after it and gets a thick outside edge that runs away into the vacant third man fence.
Grace Harris comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deepti Sharma does it again for her side and breaks the momentum. This is slower through the air and tossed up well outside the off stump. Ashleigh Gardner steps out and has to fetch it before lofting it down the ground. The ball comes off the toe end of the bat and goes straight down the throat of Harleen Deol at long on. Deol makes no mistake and Gardner's fiery innings comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Harleen Deol b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Ashleigh Gardner pre-meditates and shuffles a long way past the off stump. Deepti Sharma sees this and pushes it further wider. Gardner looks to slog it away but fails to get any bat on it.
Nicely flighted, on a shorter length and well outside the off stump. Ashleigh Gardner chases after it and looks to cut but gets an inside edge back to the keeper.
Tosses it up on a nagging length and turns it in from outside off. Ellyse Perry rocks back and pushes it toward extra cover for a quick single.
SIX! She clears the fence this time! Anjali Sarvani bowls a slower one now, short and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner picks it up and pulls it way over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Powered away! This is short and on off, Ashleigh Gardner moves across and heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Short again and on middle, Ellyse Perry miscues her pull shot through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FIFTY FOR PERRY! She has continued her form from the previous game. This is back of a length and on off, Ellyse Perry forces it wide of long off for a single. Now, she will want to take her side to a big total.
FOUR! Brilliant batting this from Australia Women! This is on a hard length and around off, Ellyse Perry waits for it and cuts it late past point for a boundary.
Harmanpreet Kaur keeps on ringing in the bowling changes as Anjali Sarvani (2-0-15-0) is brought back into the attack.
FOUR! Ashleigh Gardner connects this time alright! This is nicely tossed up, full and on off, Ashleigh Gardner gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it firmly through extra covers for a boundary.
Gives this one some air, on off, turning away, Ashleigh Gardner goes for the sweep, but fails to connect.
Looped up, on off, Ellyse Perry uses her feet, takes it on the full and drills it towards long off for a single.
Floated, full and on off, Ashleigh Gardner goes for the big heave, but gets an inside edge through square leg for a run.
A bit short and on middle, Ellyse Perry tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot! This is tossed up, full and around leg, Ellyse Perry goes down and sweeps it towards the vacant deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Shafali Verma comes back to replace Radha Yadav.
A single to end the over as this short delivery is slapped towards deep point.
Floated and down the leg, Ellyse Perry misses her flick. It is called a wide.
Devika Vaidya bowls another short ball, on middle, angling in, Ellyse Perry forces it towards mid-wicket.
Short again and on off, Ellyse Perry slaps it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter in length and outside of, Ellyse Perry cuts it hard wide of deep point for a brace.
SIX! BOOM! Ellyse Perry clears the fence this time! This is a flighted delivery, on off, Ellyse Perry skips down the track and dispatches it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Tossed up, full and on off, Ashleigh Gardner comes down the track and thrashes it towards long off for a single.
Devika Vaidya (2-0-11-0) is back on.
Short again and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner cuts it towards sweeper cover for one more. 100 up for Australia Women!
Short and outside off, Ellyse Perry punches it through point of for one.
Tossed up, full and around off, Ashleigh Gardner uses her feet again and chips it on the bounce towards long off for a run.
SIX! Up, up and away! This is flighted, on middle, Ashleigh Gardner skips down the track and lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Floated, full and on off, Ellyse Perry uses her feet and drives it towards long off for a single.
FOUR! In the gap! This is tossed up, on middle, Ellyse Perry goes down, takes it on the full and nails her sweep towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.

FOUR! A third short ball and a third boundary in the over. This is angled into the body but Ashleigh Gardner is able to just get inside the line of the ball and pull it past the fielder at deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length and on the pads, this is worked off the hips and 'round the corner for a single.
FOUR! Ellyse Perry getting back into her groove now. Drops it just a bit short again and over off stump, Perry muscles it through wide mid on and picks up a boundary.
Good comeback delivery from Renuka Singh! Slower one, on a good length and in that channel around off. Perry looks to play at it but is undone by the lack of pace.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Ellyse Perry and Australia Women. Shorter in length and over off stump, Perry rolls the wrists over the ball and pulls it well in front of the square on the leg side to find the fence.
This is pitched up around off, Ellyse Perry leans on to drive but finds the fielder at extra cover.
Renuka Singh is back on. She has conceded 12 runs in her first two overs.
Very full on middle and leg, this is driven uppishly toward long on for just one more.
Nicely tossed up around the pads, Ashleigh Gardner comes forward and eases it down to long on for a single.
Another good stop and the pressure is mounting on the Aussie batters. Shorter one around off, Ashleigh Gardner punches it off the back foot but cannot beat Harmanpreet Kaur at extra cover.
Short and around off stump, this is nudged off the back foot toward short third man for a quick single.
Flighted delivery outside off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On the shorter side and around off, Perry taps it toward point.

Direct hit and Ellyse Perry was a goner! Slower and shorter outside off, Perry rocks back and hits it hard toward wide mid off and sets off for the single. The throw is fired in at the bowler's end but the fielder misses.
Tossed up full and around off, Ellyse Perry punches it right back to the bowler.
Nicely drifted onto the pads, Perry drives it toward mid on and that's the third dot ball in a row now.
A tad shorter and around off, this is played off the back foot and onto the off side.
On a length and around off, Perry cuts it late but fails to beat the fielder at backward point.
Slower through the air and shorter outside off, this is punched off the back foot and through cover-point for one.
Change of ends for Radha Yadav.
BYE! Quicker and flatter around off, Garner misses the cut and the ball goes off the keeper's gloves toward short fine leg. They scamper through for a bye.
Excellent fielding! Tossed up outside off and shorter as well, Ashleigh Gardner rocks back to cut but Smriti Mandhana at point makes a sharp stop to her right.
SIX! Clean strike! Tossed up, right in the slot around the off stump. Ashleigh Gardner clears the front leg and thumps it right back over the bowler's head for a flat six.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut away square of the wicket for a single.
Slower through the air and the length is pulled back a bit as well. Perry taps it toward point.
Devika Vaidya starts off with a tossed-up delivery around off. Ashleigh Gardner drills it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Ellyse Perry has come out with aggressive intent. A juicy full toss outside off, Perry leans on and creams it past extra cover for a boundary.

Half a chance! This is flighted full and around off, Ashleigh Gardner hammers it uppishly and right back at the bowler who is unable to react quickly and the ball goes down to long off. They get a single.
Misfield! Floated up full and outside off, Ellyse Perry creams it straight to extra cover where Harmanpreet Kaur lets it through and allows the single.
Tossed up around off, this is stroked away through cover-point for a single.
Pushed through a bit quicker and around off stump, Gardner looks to cut but is beaten.
Shafali Verma starts off with a floater, on a length and around off stump. Ashleigh Gardner waits for it and blocks it out.
SIX! WOW! Tossed up around middle, Ellyse Perry just dances down the track and lifts it high and handsome right back over the bowler's head for a huge hit. Some way to get off the mark that.
Ellyse Perry comes in to bat next.

OUT! TIMBER! Radha Yadav strikes now! A double blow for Australia Women! Radha Yadav bowls this quicker, full and in line with the stumps, Tahlia McGrath shuffles across again to play the sweep, but gets beaten by the pace and the ball goes through to rattle the stumps. India Women are delighted as Australia Women lose their second wicket.
Tossed up, full and on off, Ashleigh Gardner looks to push it away, but chips it uppishly just in front of short covers where the fielder parries it away. They cross.
Another single as this short delivery is slapped towards deep point.
Short again and on off, Ashleigh Gardner punches it towards deep point for a run.
Short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Ouch! Alyssa Healy is looking in some discomfort and is unable to continue. A blow to the batting team as Alyssa Healy is retired hurt. Ashleigh Gardner replaces her.
This is floated, full and on off, Alyssa Healy goes for the reverse sweep, but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW, but turned down.
Halt! Alyssa Healy looks in some pain here. The physio is in to check on her. She is going to continue for now.

FOUR! Alyssa Healy finds the fence this time! Deepti Sharma follows the batter and bowls this short and way outside off, Alyssa Healy shuffles across and pulls it towards the vacant deep square leg fence for a boundary. She looks in some pain after hitting that shot.
Quciker one, short and on off, Alyssa Healy cuts it towards point.
Short again and outside off, Tahlia McGrath moves across and pulls it aerially wide of deep mid-wicket for just a run.
Tossed up, short and around off, Alyssa Healy check-drives it uppishly, but safely towards covers for a run.
Slightly shorter and on off, Alyssa Healy forces it towards short mid-wicket.
Floated, full and outside off, way outside off, Alyssa Healy leaves it alone. Wided.
Full again and on middle, Tahlia McGrath mistimes her cover drive towards mid-wicket.
Goes fuller and on middle, shaping in, Tahlia McGrath drives it towards the bowler where Anjali Sarvani goes down and parries it towards mid off.
Back of a length and on leg, Alyssa Healy works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Much better from Anjali Sarvani! She serves this full and around off, Alyssa Healy knocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly punished! This is full and on the pads, Alyssa Healy stays there and flicks it towards the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary.
This is on a good length and on middle, shaping in, Tahlia McGrath gets cramped and gets an inside edge onto her pads as the ball rolls to the off side. A leg bye is taken.
A bit short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath cuts it towards deep point for a single.

FOUR! A brilliant effort in the deep, but in vain. This is short again and outside off, Tahlia McGrath moves across and drags her pull shot wide of deep mid-wicket where Smriti Mandhana covers here ground, dives to the left, but the ball touches her fingers and goes towards the fence for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath cuts it towards point.
Tahlia McGrath walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Deepti Sharma draws first blood! India Women gets a crucial breakthrough! Deepti Sharma flights this one up, outside off, Beth Mooney skips down the track and swings across the line. However, she has to reach for it and only manages to hit it with the toe end part of the bat as the ball loops up towards mid on where Shafali Verma takes a good catch moving backwards. Australia Women lose their first!
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on off, Beth Mooney uses her feet, yorks herself and digs it out towards mid off.
Deepti Sharma starts with a short delivery outside off, Alyssa Healy cuts it wide of covers where the fielder puts in a dive to the left to stop it. They cross.
Deepti Sharma comes into the attack now.
Another dot! Renuka Singh pitches it up, on off, Beth Mooney drives it towards short covers.
Full again and on middle, Beth Mooney chips it on the bounce towards mid on.
Fuller one and on middle, angling in, Beth Mooney guides it towards short third man.
Short and outside off, Alyssa Healy cuts it through point for a run.
Back of a length and outside off, Alyssa Healy punches it wide of sweeper cover for a couple of runs where Smriti Mandhana put in a dive to keep it inside.

Brilliant bowling! Renuka Singh bowls a slower one, on a length and on middle, Beth Mooney uses here feet to push it away, but misses as the ball goes over the stumps towards the keeper. Richa Ghosh collects it and breaks the stumps at the batter's end and ball deflects towards point. The batter steal a bye run.
On a length and on middle, Alyssa Healy works it towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for Alyssa Healy! This is short of a length and outside off, Alyssa Healy goes for the cut, but gets an bottom edge past the keeper and the ball races towards the fine leg fence for four runs.
Pulls her length back a bit, on middle, shaping in, Alyssa Healy gets cramped and knocks it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nice shot! Anjali Sarvani serves this full and on middle, swinging in, Alyssa Healy nudges it away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller again and on off, Alyssa Healy pushes it towards covers.
Anjali Sarvani begins with a full delivery, on the pads, Beth Mooney flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Anjali Sarvani to share the attack.
Short and outside off, Alyssa Healy cuts it straight to point.
Tip and run! This is back of a length and on off, Beth Mooney taps it to the off side for a quick single and gets off the mark.
This is on a good length and around leg, Alyssa Healy misses her flick as the ball goes off the pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
FOUR! Lovely shot this time! Renuka Singh continues to bowl full, on off again, Alyssa Healy leans on a bit and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.

EDGED AND FOUR! Australia Women and Alyssa Healy gets underway in streaky fashion. This is full again and outsid eoff, Alyssa Healy throws her bat at it, and gets an outside edge past slip and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
A beauty to start with! Renuka Singh starts with a full delivery, around off, Alyssa Healy goes for the drive, but gets beaten on the outside edge.

We are ready for action! The players are making their way out in the middle and India Women players are taking their respective field position. The two openers for Australia Women are Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney. Renuka Singh to start proceedings with the ball. Let's play...

Alyssa Healy says that they would have liked to bowl first but aren't too bothered about it and are ready to go out and bat. Adds that they were able to absorb the pressure last time around and get the win and hope to continue the same. Says that the fielding can certainly improve and would like to hold on to a few more catches. Informs that Nicola Carey is out and Heather Graham comes back in.

India Women captain, Harmanpreet Kaur says that they will have a bowl first because in the night games it is always good to chase and they want to keep doing the same things. Adds that they will look to improve in some areas and they would want the batters to take more responsibility. Says that they have batters on their side who have the ability to do well. Informs that they have made one change to the side with Rajeshwari Gayakwad sitting out and Harleen Deol coming in.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (C/WK), Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Grace Harris, Annabel Sutherland, Heather Graham (In for Nicola Carey), Alana King, Megan Schutt and Darcie Brown.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Devika Vaidya, Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Harleen Deol (In for Rajeshwari Gayakwad), Radha Yadav, Anjali Sarvani and Renuka Singh.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they will BOWL first.

India Women have done a lot of things right in this series but have been outclassed by some individual brilliance from the opposition players. The top order for India has runs in it and their frontline seamers look good as well. The middle order does need to step up a bit more though. It will be interesting to see if either side tinkers with their playing XI in this important clash. Stay tuned as the toss and team news aren't far away.

Australia Women recovered from a heartbreaking defeat in a Super Over in the second game to overpower the Indians in the third game and take back the lead in the series. The form of Ellyse Perry with the bat will be a welcome sight for them and given the way Grace Harris played last time around, they will be optimistic about taking an unassailable lead here. They will however be looking for some consistency in that top order and a few tweaks here and there in the bowling department as well.

Hello and a warm welcome to the fourth game of the five-match T20I series between India Women and Australia Women at the Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai. The penultimate game of the series is a crucial one as the hosts can level the series and make the final game an interesting one whereas the visitors can seal the series right here and right now. Either way, it promises to be filled with excitement.
... MATCH DAY ...

It is now time for the penultimate match of this 5-match T20I series between India Women and Australia Women's. The visitors have an upper hand coming into the game with them leading the series 2-1. They have a golden opportunity here to seal the series. India Women would be really disappointed with the way they bowled in the middle overs as it swung the momentum in the favour of the opposition. India seems to be a solid outfit and will surely not make it easy for Australia Women to walk back with the series. With just a final opportunity for India to level the series, they will be coming out with all guns blazing. India surely needs to focus on the flow of run rate in the middle overs and make sure to not let the game slip away from them. The middle order also needs to pull their socks up with the blade because they cannot afford to lack in any department against this formidable Australia Women's side. Will India Women be able to level the series? Or will Australia Women be able to take an unassailable lead in this series? We shall find out together.
